title: Run every Biblicus call through one BiblicusRunner (PyPI Biblicus, BIBLICUS_WORKDIR)
description: Replace the five hand-written Biblicus subprocess bridges (and the other uv run / python -m biblicus call sites) with papyrus_content.biblicus_runner.BiblicusRunner, which runs the installed biblicus console script, owns environment, working directory, JSON parsing and typed errors, and validates output with biblicus.api models. Remove BIBLICUS_ROOT, the sibling-checkout default, uv run and the dependency-retry fallback. BIBLICUS_WORKDIR is required. Links to Biblicus blbs-af04bd. Corpus data migrations are out of scope.
